tagline.en: A multi-agent world model for StarCraft, generating action-conditioned video via a served endpoint.
tagline.zh: 一个面向 StarCraft 的多智能体世界模型,通过服务端点生成动作条件视频。

en: StarWM is a world model for StarCraft-style multi-agent settings. It predicts action-conditioned video — given the game state and actions, it models how the scene unfolds — making it a testbed for world modeling in complex multi-agent environments.

In WorldFoundry the official offline inference client is vendored in-tree. Jobs use StarWM's OpenAI-compatible endpoint parameters and the official prompt fixture format; the route builds the inference command and validates the input file, mode, and model id before running. Actual generation requires a running OpenAI-compatible StarWM endpoint.
zh: StarWM 是面向 StarCraft 式多智能体场景的世界模型。它预测动作条件视频——给定游戏状态与动作,建模场景如何演化——因而成为复杂多智能体环境中世界建模的试验平台。
在 WorldFoundry 中,官方离线推理客户端已内置。任务使用 StarWM 的 OpenAI 兼容端点参数与官方提示词 fixture 格式;该路由会构建推理命令,并在执行前校验输入文件、模式与模型 id。实际生成需要一个运行中的 OpenAI 兼容 StarWM 端点。

whenToUse.en: When you want to model action-conditioned dynamics in StarCraft-style multi-agent scenes and can run an OpenAI-compatible StarWM endpoint.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想在 StarCraft 式多智能体场景中建模动作条件动态,并能运行一个 OpenAI 兼容 StarWM 端点时。

notFor.en: Generation depends on a running OpenAI-compatible StarWM endpoint with a served model id — it is not a self-contained local generator.
notFor.zh: 生成依赖一个运行中的、带 served model id 的 OpenAI 兼容 StarWM 端点——它不是自包含的本地生成器。

en: Multi-agent world model for StarCraft-style scenes
Official offline inference client vendored in-tree
Runs against an OpenAI-compatible served endpoint
zh: 面向 StarCraft 式场景的多智能体世界模型
内置官方离线推理客户端
对接 OpenAI 兼容的服务端点运行
